semantics.contextual_score: maximum raw logit over all complete query/body/ancestor-context windows and original/translation lanes
semantics.own_body_score: maximum raw logit over all complete query/body/heading-only-context windows and original/translation lanes
semantics.heading_context: exact ancestor and current heading lines only; no ancestor introductory bodies
semantics.pairs: sum of both exhaustive scoring passes
semantics.threshold: minimum combined score across every calibration unit independently labelled useful
semantics.closure: unchanged exact structural closure, no top-k or budget-driven membership
